lines: Phase 3, the look lock: the scaffold is in. One frame object feeds every module, each part of winter has its own file and one owner, and the fit tool draws the build with the approved image's own camera and prints the difference.
The winter miniature is split in two owners (cottage, fence, lamppost, pond and ground; trunk, crown and star). 305 tests green.

Next: ten build agents start on the glass, the liquid and simulation, the particles and veil, the slab and backdrop, the winter base with icicles, the two halves of the miniature, the frost, the light engine and the shake.
The published app still shows the Phase 2 stand-in globe; it is published again as soon as the first real parts are merged.
phase 3: 1.30 h used of its 11.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 7.91 h used of 36.00 h allowed
